note: Issue #611: rules every race shares. Read by src/systems/racing/race_crew.gd. line_up_reach: how close to the grid (m) your speeder must be for [Z]. countdown_s: seconds per count (3, 2, 1, GO). grid_timeout_s: a racer still driving to the grid this long after it drove off is set on its slot. Speeder race lag fix: build_near_m, how close (m) to a crew's hangout you come before their parked speeders are built (one a physics tick; they stay, asleep while you are far); leave_stagger_s, seconds between racers setting off for their speeders after you accept; board_grace_s, a racer still walking to its speeder this long after setting off is sat on it; cruise_pace (0..1 of top speed), how fast they drive to the grid and home again, no boost; walk_home_m, parked back home with you this close they walk back to their spot, else they are set down there; crowd_every_ticks, the crowd at the line is built one body every this many physics ticks, then the track beast. beep / go_sound: Sound keys (content/look/sound.json). crowd_profiles: the soldier profiles spectators are drawn from (random local looks). crowd_band: where they stand, beside the start line, [min, max] metres out from each antenna and [min, max] metres behind the line. return_s: after the race, how long the racers have to drive back and park before anyone still out is set down at their spot. results_s: how long (real seconds) the finishing order stays up after the race, then it fades out over results_fade_s. Issue #618: gate_boost_off (0..1, how near a checkpoint's centre counts as clean) and gate_boost (the share of the boost tank it gives back); finish_cam and finish_filter (switches), finish_gap_s (another racer this close to the line in time makes a close finish), finish_slow (time scale), finish_cam_s (real seconds), finish_fov, finish_cam_side_m, finish_filter_look (letterbox bar height, vignette strength, warm tint). Drafting and the boost's camera widening are the speeder's (speeder.json). Issue #617: pink_slips (on or off) and owned_cap, the most speeders you can own (won or kept; never more than the row outside the back gate has spots). collect: Dorrin's prompt for winnings an old save still has him holding (a win now pays your credits at the finish). Shoot first: shoot_back (on or off), fire your lasers, a seeker or a mine once the race is on and every racer may shoot at you from then on, whatever the crew's shoot_from_lap or hold_fire_gates say (lines shot_first, one of them shouts it; rule_shoot_back, the menu's word on it; rule_gate, the menu's rule for a crew that holds fire till a checkpoint, {gates} the count). Issue #616: seeker_chance_s and mine_chance_s, a racer's chance each second (while it may fight) of firing a seeker at you in its nose or dropping a mine with you within mine_behind_m behind it. hud: the race HUD's words. Crash-outs: crash_repair_s, lose your hull mid-race and your speeder does not burst: it stops dead and smokes this many seconds while it is patched up (no throttle, no guns, no more hits), then it is back at full hull and you race on (hud crashed / repairing / repaired are its words). npc_crash_repair_s, the same for a racer the crew brought, a bit longer: wreck one and it sits out that long, then races on. Rematch: lines, crew lines every crew shares (a crew's own file can override any): rematch is the [Z] prompt on your speeder near the line while they head home (same stake, paid from your credits and then what Dorrin holds), rematch_poor the line when you cannot cover it (they just head home), rematch_accept the leader's answer, rematch_option the first row in the leader's menu afterwards. Race quests: quests, the optional quests a race offers when it ends (RaceCrew.quests; {crew} is the crew's label, {Crew} the same without "the" and capitalised). Win and you are offered next (race the crew above them on the ladder, pointing at where that crew hangs out; done when you beat them) and slips (a pink-slip race against the crew you beat; done when one is run); lose and you are offered rematch (race the crew who beat you again; done when you beat them). One per crew: the job log holds one line per crew (its name, its difficulty, the crew file's `difficulty`, and where you stand: Race, Rematch or Pink slip), so offering one clears that crew's other race quests (RaceCrew.settle_quests). Issue #722: that full hull needs a plasma welder: hold E in the seat for its weld_s and you are back at full hull at once; the patch-up alone puts you back at the welder's unwelded_hull (half). hud weld_hint / no_welder say which.
